prepared_for: Northwind Studio, Jamie Example, Office Manager
photo_caption: The display card on a real pantry shelf.
headline: Vetted emerging snacks and drinks, free, roughly monthly.
lead: You pick the categories and can veto anything. All we ask: on the shelf the day it arrives, one photo, and three questions for your team.
gets:
One to three vetted emerging brands per drop, free, roughly monthly as supply allows.
Only the categories you choose, and a veto on any brand.
One contact. Deliveries on Tuesday or Wednesday mornings, in your receiving window.
A display card, so your team knows what it is and what is in it.
Your team's feedback, summarized for you after each drop.
gives:
A named pantry owner and a receiving window.
On the shelf within one business day of delivery.
One placement photo, then one more on day 3 or 5.
One Slack or email post of the survey link; five or more responses.
A ten-minute debrief, and your Tuesday headcount.
never: Never asked of you: payment, employees' contact details, exclusivity, or storing anything beyond the drop.
steps:
A short intake form: categories, vetoes, Tuesday headcount, receiving window.
We propose a brand. You approve it by reply, or veto it.
A Tuesday or Wednesday morning: one labeled case and a display card arrive.
Five business days later the survey closes, and you get your team's feedback.
product:
Sealed, individually packaged, shelf-stable, labeled with ingredients and allergens.
Never alcohol, cannabis or CBD, supplements, anything refrigerated or needing preparation, or health claims.
privacy: No personal data about your employees. The survey is anonymous: no login, no email. An optional newsletter box, unticked, sends an email to the brand only if someone ticks it.
founding:
First drop within four weeks of signing.
Named on the founding roster only if you say yes.
Veto and category profile, changeable any time.
Leave any time with a week's notice.
sign: **What you sign:** a one-page participation agreement listing what each side commits to. No fees either way.
next: **Next step:** reply with a yes and I will send the intake form, or pick 15 minutes for a call.
card_caption: What your team sees: the brand, who makes it, a QR code for three questions, the allergen statement word for word from the package, and where to buy it nearby.
